name: giant wolf spider
desc: Giant Wolf Spider is a CR 0.25 beast.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=RDbtJIrHQobdffi4]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but &reference[poisoned] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=RDbtJIrHQobdffi4]], even after regaining hit points, and is &reference[paralyzed apply=false] while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: spider climb
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: web sense
actions.desc: While in contact with a web, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: web walker
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
